fair_value_reason: NTM non-GAAP EPS at Sep-2027 ~$20 (0.25 x $15.58 FY27 + 0.75 x ~$21.5 FY28) x 30x = ~$600, /1.045 for expected warrant and World Labs dilution = ~$574, + ~$6/share net cash ($13.1B cash and ST investments vs $3.25B debt) = ~$580, less ~$3/share expected cost of the customer-financing stack (guarantee losses, haircut on customer investments, unrecovered lease cost) = ~$577. This corrects agent_5's low NTM revenue (its FV would be ~$582) and agent_4's forward net cash that ignores the investment commitments (~$568). It keeps 30x rather than agent_3's 29x. The agents' mean is $571.4. At ~4.5% below spot, fair value sits well within the ~$19/share-per-turn uncertainty of the shared multiple.
supervisor_summary: In round 2 the five forecasters converged on $550-585 fair value (mean $571), using the same inputs: FY27 EPS $15.58, NTM ~$20, ~30x, ~4-4.5% dilution and $9.9B net cash. The ladders put P(close >= $604 spot) at ~0.49. The customer-financing exposure agent_3 raised is real but modest. The $4.1B lease guarantees have been flat since Q1. The new post-quarter $5.0B investment and $9.5B lease commitments cost ~$2-4/share in expectation and mainly deepen the left tail in an AI-capex downturn. My reconciled fair value is ~$577, 4.5% below spot and within the ~$19/share-per-turn error of the shared multiple, so there is no edge in either direction and the forecasters' mean ladder stands (low confidence).
key_drivers: Management guided 2027 data-center revenue to more than double, server revenue up >70%, and EPS to 'significantly exceed' $20. FY27 consensus is $15.58 (50 analysts), up from $13.18 90 days earlier. Q3 guide is $13.0B +/- $0.3B.

The pace of the Helios/MI450 ramp to the first GW each at OpenAI, Meta and Anthropic in 1H27. Production is confirmed and volume is the open question. That pace decides whether FY27 lands near $15.6 or near a $12-13 bear case.

Valuation already prices consensus: ~39x FY27 / ~42x NTM. All five forecasters assume de-rating to ~29-30x NTM, and each 1x is ~$19/share, so the ~4.5% gap to spot is within the error of that assumption.
Dilution of ~4-4.5% by the horizon (first-GW tranches of the 320M $0.01 OpenAI/Meta warrants plus ~13.6M World Labs shares) is outside consensus EPS.

Vendor financing is growing: $4.1B lease guarantees (flat since Q1), $30.3B purchase commitments (up from $25.7B), and after quarter-end up to $5.0B of investment commitments and $9.5B of new data-center leases. The expected cost is small (~$2-4/share), but it deepens a capex downturn.
